name: Neural Radar
description: A live neural map of your running agents and their subagents. You sit at the centre; the more an agent needs you, the closer it moves. Click an agent to jump to its session, approve a plan, send it a message or stop it.
author: eskwisit

en.name: Neural Radar
en.description: A live neural map of your running agents and their subagents. You sit at the centre; the more an agent needs you, the closer it moves. Click an agent to jump to its session, approve a plan, send it a message or stop it.
en.safetyNotes: Uses the high-risk desktop.control permission to read the session list, agent status, transcripts (last 60 messages), subagents and pending plans, and, only when you click in the drawer, to open a session, send a message, approve or reject a plan, or stop or abort a turn (stop and abort need a second confirming click). composer.suggest only pre-fills the session composer when you click. ui.view docks the radar in the work panel. No network access, no file access, and nothing stored besides its own setting.

zh-CN.name: 神经雷达
zh-CN.description: 实时神经网络图，展示正在运行的智能体及其子智能体。你位于中心，越需要你的智能体离你越近。点击智能体即可跳转到它的会话、批准计划、发送消息或停止它。
zh-CN.safetyNotes: 使用高风险权限 desktop.control 读取会话列表、智能体状态、对话记录（最近 60 条消息）、子智能体和待批准的计划；只有在你于抽屉中点击时，才会打开会话、发送消息、批准或拒绝计划、停止或中止当前轮次（停止和中止需要再次点击确认）。composer.suggest 仅在你点击时预填会话输入框。ui.view 将雷达停靠在工作面板中。不访问网络，不访问文件，除自身设置外不存储任何内容。
